Vendored third-party assets (served under /static/vendor/, loaded
lazily by the details-page reaction picker):

- picmo.js, picmo.css — PicMo 5.8.5 (MIT)
  https://github.com/joeattardi/picmo  ·  https://picmojs.com
  Byte-identical upstream dist files; no local patches. The picker is
  fed emojiData + messages directly (the createPicker options path
  that bypasses its internal CDN fetches), so nothing phones home.

- emojibase-data/en/data.json, messages.json — Emojibase Data 15.3.2
  (MIT)  https://github.com/milesj/emojibase
  Full (non-compact) English dataset: the per-entry schema (emoji,
  label, version, order, group, tags, skins, hexcode) is exactly what
  PicMo 5.x ingests — no transform layer needed.

Upgrades: refresh both from the same era (picmo 5.x pairs with
emojibase-data <= 15.x schemas) and re-run the picker smoke test.

Note: picmo.js retains a //# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map comment
(no .map vendored) — devtools logs a harmless 404 when the picker is
inspected; left in place to keep the file byte-identical to upstream.
